title: H1: first CrowdWorks screen + proposals under PG-1 conditions (≤5/day combined with Coconala)
detail: Owner completed CrowdWorks account + 本人確認 (10/08). Work marketing/2026-10/h1/CROWDWORKS_PLAYBOOK.md: categories §1, GO filter §2, SELECTION PRIORITY §2.5 (Day-8 lever analysis: budget ¥10,000–15,000 so one order meets G2; early applicant ≤3rd–5th by 応募数; objective done-condition; free dummy-data sample offered). Send ≤5/day combined with Coconala, each logged as proposal_sent --grant PG-1 with conditions 1-7 + signal --channel crowdworks. Record EVERY screened request (url, budget, 応募数, go/no-go, reason) in marketing/2026-10/h1/screens/crowdworks-2026-10-08.md — the review needs qualified-requests/day (supply). Profile: the mac-local profile (owner was asked to log in there). If crowdworks.jp is NOT logged in on that profile, do not sweep other sites: release with --blocked-by owner-crowdworks-login and file ONE single-site login request. On done: create h1-crowdworks-scan-<MMDD> for the next day 10:00 JST.
acceptance: screen file with per-request supply data; sends logged with PG-1 conditions; next-day scan task created
